schema.description: Request body for creating a Customer.

referenceId.description: The ID of the customer in your own system, such as the user ID of your website. It is unique per environment, so two Customers of the same environment can't share it. When another Customer already has it, the request fails with `409 Conflict`.

language.description: The language to write to the Customer in, as an ISO 639-1 two-letter code such as `it` or `en`.

companyId.description: The ID of the Company this Customer is associated with.

metadata.description: Set of key-value pairs that you can attach to an object. This can be useful for storing additional information about the object in a structured format. It can contain up to 10 key-value items with a maximum length of 40 for the key and of 400 chars for the value.
metadata.title: Metadata

consents.description: The choices the Customer made about marketing and profiling, as you collected them. Each one is kept in the consent register with its date, text and version.

items.description: One choice of the Customer as you collected it. IP address and user agent are the Customer's, not your server's.

purpose.description: What the consent is for. `Marketing` is receiving promotional messages on a channel; `Profiling` is the analysis of the purchase history to tailor offers.

channel.description: Required for a marketing consent, and not allowed for profiling.

granted.description: True when the Customer gives the consent, false when they refuse or revoke it.

collectedAt.description: When the Customer made the choice. It cannot be in the future. A choice older than the current one for the same purpose and channel is ignored.

source.description: Where the choice was collected. Defaults to `Other`.

text.description: The text the Customer was shown. Required when `granted` is true.

version.description: The version of that text in your own system.

ipAddress.description: The IP address of the Customer when they made the choice.

userAgent.description: The user agent of the Customer's browser when they made the choice.

items.title: Customers.ConsentRequest

requireUniqueEmail.description: If true, the API will return an error if a customer with the same email address already exists. If false, allows duplicate emails.
